item.tib: dran pa tshe sgrab kyi cha lag me tog mdzes pa'i do shal
item.coloph: ces khod spungs dran pa 'chi med tshe yi rdzong chen gyi cha lag me tog mdzes pa'i do shal 'di ni/ 'gru rtse bla ma bsod nams dbang ldan a yu khod spyod sogs/ mched grogs 'ga'i thugs bzhed ltar/ dran pa gsang sgrub dang tshe sgrub dang sbrag mar na 'di mi dgos kyang / tshe sgrub rkyang par byed na gsang sgrub nas nyer mkhor bsdus pa mi chung ming chen 'dzin pa kun grol grags pa yis/ dbang phyug ces pa me glang dri zhim ngad ldan gyi zla bar sgo gsum bcad rgyar gnas pa'i thun mtshams su bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/
